name: The Videre Elixir
summary: Bring Gregan Brewspewer an Evoroot, and he can brew the Videre Elixir. He boasts of his knowledge of herbs and alchemy.

sections.title: An Evoroot for the Brewer
sections.body: Gregan Brewspewer needs an Evoroot before he can brew your Videre Elixir. He boasts that he knows a great many things about herbs and alchemy, then begins a tale about turning the cheese meant for lunch into gold. When you walk away, he asks where you are going. Ask Gregan where to find an Evoroot.

sections.title: When the Evoroot Arrives
sections.body: When you return with the Evoroot, Gregan greets you with a claim: you pulled a fast one on old Miblon.

aliases: where do i get videre elixir
faq.answer: Gregan Brewspewer can brew the Videre Elixir once you bring him an Evoroot.

faq.q: What ingredient is required to make the elixir?
faq.answer: Gregan needs an Evoroot to make the elixir. Ask him where to find one.

faq.q: What does Gregan Brewspewer boast about?
faq.answer: Gregan boasts that he knows a great many things about herbs and alchemy. He begins a tale about turning a lunchtime cheese into gold.
